why: The TUI runs autopilot detached; on Windows a detached process has no console, so every console program it started without windowsHide (omp.exe, git, cargo) opened a new visible terminal window.
fix: Import spawn / spawnSync from src/core/proc.js: same signatures, windowsHide on by default. (src/adapters/omp.js is exempt: its import is template text for omp's own hook.)
